records.reviewer: Independent agent reviewer · blinded shoulder comparison and unblinded CT and chapter review
records.task: Follow the left thyroid lobe along its long axis and locate its connection to the isthmus.

scoreEvidence.fidelity: The three saved left longitudinal cuts stay within 2.32 mm. On an additional +0.75 mm parallel cut the in-plane gap is 4.13 mm while local 3D distance is 0.64 mm. This limits agreement for contour tracing.
scoreEvidence.form: The left shoulder has a continuous broad highlight in front and side close-ups. The reverse view retains the lower-lobe indentation. The central bridge and lower-lobe relief are softer than the historical r01.
scoreEvidence.readability: The left lobe can be followed in the oblique frame-48 view. The axial orbit and the transverse entry clarify the connection over the trachea. The probe and grid partly overlap the target.
scoreEvidence.economy: The 5,900-triangle surface has the same packed cost as r03. Relative to the dense shaped surface, maximum silhouette departure is 0.50 px across 24 views at 3 px/mm.

records.disposition: Adopt for the named 3D orientation task
records.note: Separate-subject exterior orientation. Close agreement on the frozen cuts supports that learner action. Arbitrary scan-contour tracing, volume calipers and clinical findings remain unqualified.

comparison.label: Thyroid shoulder before and after the correction
comparison.candidateLabel: Matched front, reverse and bridge views compare the shipped r03 and r04 exports.

views.label: R03, raw CT label and r04
views.candidateLabel: R04 follows the lobe outline without reproducing raw axial terraces. The reverse view retains the lower lobe indentation.

views.label: Protected bilateral long-axis cuts
views.candidateLabel: The left trio stays within 2.32 mm. An additional parallel section 0.75 mm from the center has a 4.13 mm in-plane miss and a 0.64 mm local 3D distance.

views.label: Isthmus sections and transverse entry
views.candidateLabel: Five sagittal sections stay within 0.84 mm. The transverse entry preserves the connection between lobes.

views.label: Bilateral thyroid sweeps at frame 12
views.candidateLabel: R03 and r04 use the same pose and scan images. The overlay shows the gland above the tracheal air column.

views.label: Bilateral long-axis CT companions
views.candidateLabel: The probe and grid partly obscure the gland in the default view. The axial orbit and overlay help locate the lobe and its bridge.
